entries.label: gym_denki_010_kari_message_01

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Welcome to the Levincia Gym,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].
entries.label: gym_denki_040_receptionist_00

entries.text: Are you ready to challenge Gym Leader Iono,\nthe Supercharged Streamer?
entries.label: gym_denki_040_receptionist_01

entries.text: Very well. Allow me to show you to the\nbattle court.
entries.label: gym_denki_040_receptionist_02

entries.text: Understood. Please feel free to come speak to\nme whenever you’re ready.
entries.label: gym_denki_040_receptionist_03

entries.text: Ladies and gentlemens! Are you readyyyyyy?![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_entry_01

entries.text: Your eyeballs are MINE—caught in my\nElectroweb! Whosawhatsit? Iono!\c\n’Ello, ’ello, hola! Ciao and bonjour![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_01

entries.text: >’Ello, ’ello, hola!
entries.label: gym_denki_040_comment_00

entries.text: It’s time for the Iono Zone, everybody![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_15

entries.text: [EMPTY 39]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_kari_01

entries.text: Today’s challenger is flyin’ high like a Wattrel!\nIiit’s [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Yayyy![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_02

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]How’re ya feelin’ about this battle,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_03

entries.text: Ready to do my best!
entries.label: gym_denki_040_select_01

entries.text: Like I can’t lose!
entries.label: gym_denki_040_select_02

entries.text: I’m honestly a little worried...
entries.label: gym_denki_040_select_03

entries.text: Boom! We got a straight talker here, ’eyyy?\nNo nonsense! I like it![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_04a

entries.text: Hey heyyy! We got a lively one here! You’d make\na gnarly influencer, friendo![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_04b

entries.text: Oh ho hooo? Playing timid, eh? Nyahaha! I don’t\nhate it![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_04c

entries.text: All righty, then! Who’s ready to see me kick\nsome butt?[VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_05

entries.text: >I’m ready!
entries.label: gym_denki_040_comment_01

entries.text: >Finally!
entries.label: gym_denki_040_comment_02

entries.text: >Battle! Battle!
entries.label: gym_denki_040_comment_03

entries.text: >Electro King gave [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]5,000[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_comment_04

entries.text: Looks like you’re all gettin’ hyped! Ah... Thank ye\nmuchly, Electro King![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_06

entries.text: Let’s get this show on the road! How strong is\nour challenger? I ’unno! Let’s find out together![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_07

entries.text: Our challenger came out victorious! Well done,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_08

entries.text: >Whoa!
entries.label: gym_denki_040_comment_05

entries.text: >IONO!!!
entries.label: gym_denki_040_comment_06

entries.text: >You’re both so strong.
entries.label: gym_denki_040_comment_07

entries.text: I hate to say it, but I lost! Thanks for cheerin’ me\non anywho, my loyal fans![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_09

entries.text: Well then! What does our challenger get for\nbeating me—the lean, mean streamin’ queen?\r\nI’ll tell ya! [VAR 0x0100(0000)], you win...[VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_10

entries.text: a Gym Badge! Woo-hoo![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_11

entries.text: Screencap this quick! This’ll be a shot you’ll\nwanna save in your brainspaces forever![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_12

entries.text: By the bysies, with [VAR 0x0200(0001)] Gym Badge[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s, Poké pals of\nup to Lv. [VAR 0x0201(0002)] will be easier to catch! They’ll listen\r\nto ya when you ask ’em to do stuff, too![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_badge

entries.text: By the bysies, with all 8 Gym Badges, you can\ncatch Poké pals of any level, and they’ll ALL\r\nlisten to ya when you ask ’em to do stuff![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_badge_all

entries.text: And as my thanks for such a sweet pic, I’mma\ngive you a Tee Em![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_waza

entries.text: If any of you found our electrifying battle to be—\nbzzzt!—shocking, go smash that subscribe button![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_13

entries.text: Your eyeballs are MINE—caught in my\nElectroweb! Whosawhatsit? Iono the\r\nSupercharged Streamer! Catch y’all later![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_040_denki_14

entries.text: Congratulations! You’re now certified by the\nLevincia Gym!
entries.label: gym_denki_040_receptionist_04
